name: Washizuka Ennosuke
source:
The protagonist of this work. He is the illegitimate child of a certain samurai family. He lost his father before he was born and his mother went missing.

He is under the care of a temple and is thus permitted to live at the temple. He typically works as a scribe or as helper for a merchant family, other times he does requests on the behalf of Kuroji, a close friend.

He stands at 4'6" (140cm). He has a thin and slender figure.  When you use the "Futanari Girls Patch" the main character becomes a futanari and a becomes voiced. Their bust is 60cm as a boy and 72cm when futanari.
